summary: Boundary County, ID site with a 1937 entry of unknown type, abandoned in the 1940s and listed as gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source describes what, if anything, remains on the peak

events.note: Dated 1937 with the type unknown (firelookout.com). The Bethlehem Mountain entry describes a 1937 pole tower on the southwest point of Tungston Mountain; not confirmed as the same structure

evidence.supports: about seven miles southwest of Eastport
1937 pole tower on the southwest point of Tungston Mtn, destroyed 1950s
evidence.quote: 1937: 20' pole L-4 tower atop southwest point of Tungston Mtn. Destroyed 1950s.

corrections.why: firelookout.com gives 'Abandoned 1940s' and Idaho Fire Lookouts gives '1940’s – Abandoned'. Neither names 1940 as the year

notes_for_editor: Very thin sourcing. The only dated item is 1937 with an unknown type. The Bethlehem Mountain entry (firelookout.com/id/bethlehem.html) places a 1937 20-foot pole L-4 tower on the southwest point of Tungston Mountain; a human should decide whether that is the same structure, and whether the Bethlehem Mountain site needs its own record. No staffing history is documented (Idaho Fire Lookouts says so). Access is not stated in any source read, so no access key was written.
